Two caveats: the single scored notification contains an unresolved contradiction, dated 2026-10-18 while citing an original due date of 2026-10-18 yet scored at 36 days past due; and the news component contributes 0.35 x 0.0 from a screen that returned no article, no parent and no evidence record of any kind, so that portion of the formula carries no information rather than confirming a clean record — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence, and it should be confirmed the screen actually ran.

There is no independent signal to corroborate or offset the payment deterioration, and the sudden shift from 3-6 days late to 36 days warrants monitoring for further extension regardless of the current band.
